run_gguf_editor_gui: run the GGUF Editor GUI application optionally loading a model file at startup via command line argument
open_gguf_file: open a GGUF file and display its metadata and tensor information in the editor interface
edit_tokenizer_data: edit tokenizer data including tokens, token types, and scores with filtering and pagination support
edit_array_metadata: edit array-valued metadata fields with filtering, pagination, and bulk edit capabilities for enum types
add_metadata_entry: add a new metadata key-value pair with automatic type conversion for supported GGUF value types
